fields.acceptance: Profile first, before any code change, and again after: go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza, then in this repo's main checkout RHIZA_CPUPROFILE=$TMPDIR/check.prof $TMPDIR/rhiza-x check and go tool pprof -top -cum $TMPDIR/rhiza-x $TMPDIR/check.prof; the commit's Checks: block gives /usr/bin/time -f '%e s' for both builds and the cumulative shares of decode (store.ReadLog), changeset.FoldLog, as-is and what-if building and the render comparison, before and after. Tests: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/check passes, and a new test (TestWhatIfOnceMatches) over a log with a landed base, two in-flight change sets where one depends on the other, and one whose ops no longer apply shows that check's problems and rendered-file findings equal those of the old double WhatIf path. Failure case: an in-flight change set whose what-if has problems reports each problem once, not twice. Touches internal/check/check.go and its tests. Must not change what check reports or its --json shape.
fields.statement: rhiza check builds the as-is model once (model.AsIsState) and each in-flight change set's what-if view once from that seed (model.WhatIfFrom), and the in-flight problems pass (internal/check/check.go:384) and the rendered-file pass (:456) share those views, instead of calling model.WhatIf twice per in-flight change set

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/store passes, and a new test (TestReadEntriesParallelSame) over a log of a few hundred entries with an unreadable file, an entry that does not decode and an entry whose ID does not match its path shows the parallel result deep-equals the serial one; go test -race -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/store -run ReadEntries is clean. Measure in the commit's Checks: block: /usr/bin/time -f '%e s' $TMPDIR/rhiza-x check in this repo's main checkout, before and after, built as in @{01M7GFXTMA9VHC2FAQB33P1KA1}; with both leaves, within 5 s on the 4-core VM. Failure case: with GOMAXPROCS=1 it decodes on one worker and still returns the same Log. Touches internal/store/read.go and its tests. Must not add a dependency or change the order or content of Problems.
fields.statement: store.ReadEntries (internal/store/read.go:97) decodes entry files on up to four workers (bounded by GOMAXPROCS), the way the index's listing already stats folders in parallel, and returns the same Log as the serial decode: the same entries and problems in the same order
